SELECT 
  tr.transreg,
  tr.transtime,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob' as spoofprob,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore' as frontscore,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex' as qstuffindex,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' as washsus,
  tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' as layerind,
  CASE WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'Low' THEN 0.1
       WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
       WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'High' THEN 1.0 END as wash_norm,
  CASE WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'None' THEN 0.0
       WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
       WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 END as layer_norm
FROM transactionrecord tr
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tr.transtime) >= 2024
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  tr.transreg,
  ROUND(CAST(
    0.3 * (tr.risk_indicators->>'spoofprob')::numeric / 100 +
    0.2 * (tr.risk_indicators->>'frontscore')::numeric / 100 +
    0.1 * (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric +
    0.2 * CASE WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'Low' THEN 0.1
               WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'Medium' THEN 0.5
               WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus' = 'High' THEN 1.0 END +
    0.2 * CASE WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'None' THEN 0.0
               WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
               WHEN tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind' = 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0 END
  AS numeric), 4) as sai
FROM transactionrecord tr
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tr.transtime) >= 2024
LIMIT 5;

  AS numeric), 4) * 100,
